criteria.statement: Positive activation requires an explicit priority-queue snapshot-rendering request with supplied records; mention-only requests do not activate, absent records require clarification, and combined external work remains outside the boundary.
Contracts render valid records by descending integer priority, preserve original order for equal priorities, and copy id, priority, payload, and optional note values without rewriting.
Contracts preserve invalid records and received values in original order and report every applicable missing, non-integer, or out-of-range reason without coercion or clamping.
Contracts prohibit coercion, clamping, deduplication, job execution, and file, network, Git, queue, or other external-state access.
Each of the three trusted claims is represented atomically and linked reciprocally through contracts and observability requirements with grounded usage and stress coverage.
Evidence paths distinguish direct capture of observable outputs or prohibited effects from deterministic or semantic assessment, with assessments referencing observations from the same path.
The candidate does not invent decision thresholds, uncertainty limits, population facts, external observations, capability eligibility, expected answers, or oracle content.

The system-composed Blueprint is canonical, complete, BLOCKED by the trusted required-absent uncertainty fact, development-only, decision-ineligible, NOT_QUALIFIED, and preserves every frozen identity and composition invariant.

qualificationCases.description: An alternative Blueprint uses different wording while preserving all activation, rendering, invalid-record, safety, linkage, and evidence-path semantics.
A fluent Blueprint sorts descending but omits preservation of original order for equal priorities.
A Blueprint invents an uncertainty threshold despite the decision owner's explicit required-absent fact.
An evidence path labels semantic interpretation as direct capture and provides no distinct assessment over the captured observation.
